* feat: add RFC 6749 compliant refresh token flow and pluggable store

- Add RFC 6749 (OAuth 2.0) compliant refresh token support with secure, opaque server-side tokens.
- Implement pluggable refresh token store (in-memory as default, extensible to Redis, etc.).
- Change refresh endpoints to POST and update documentation/examples for RFC-compliant flows.
- Add new error types, token management helpers, and deprecate legacy refresh logic.
- Update token response to include access token, refresh token, and RFC 6749 fields.
- Add new core and store packages with TokenStore interface and in-memory store implementation.
- Extensive tests and benchmarks for in-memory refresh token store.
- Update to github.com/golang-jwt/jwt/v5 throughout codebase.
